delivery: Complete buildings only, one .vox per treatment; no cell files or brushes.
beside: ChatGPT's poke_b buildings (PokeB_DomeLab and the rest, output/poke_b/buildings/) are kept as they were: these are the game-ready redo, named PokeB_Game..., the user's choice to keep both.

families.title: Domed lab
families.drawn: The large building at the top left: two storeys under a flat red roof inside a parapet with a raised middle, a dome with a glazed band, fluted corner pilasters, a glass door under a sign.

families.title: Red clinic
families.drawn: The red-roofed building at the top middle: a white parapet, a skylight, dark corner pillars, a red portico over the door with a roundel on it, a sign, a tank and a dark teal window.

families.title: Gray mansard house with a door
families.drawn: The middle house: a grey mansard storey with two dormers and a chimney over tan boards on a stone base; a door up a stair, a window, a shallow bay.

families.title: Gray mansard house with three windows
families.drawn: The house to its right: the same mansard storey over brown boards with three windows and two shutters, no door on its front.

families.title: Cyan mansard house
families.drawn: The house at the bottom left: the middle house again, its mansard teal, its boards brown, its door orange.

families.title: Flower cottage
families.drawn: The cottage at the bottom right: cream walls, a bell-cast roof with two roof lights, flower boxes under the upper windows, a hooded door and bay, an outside stair on its right.
